description: The Bitcoin Wizard (Adam Livingston) intro for Super Saylor. Single tweet, under 280 raw chars. Leads with Adam's own line (astrology in loafers) so it reads as an affectionate homage, not a promo blast. Tag @AdamBLiv is optional (he may amplify to exactly our audience); drop it if you'd rather not tag. No em dashes, kind parody.
tweets:
Adam Livingston calls finance "astrology in loafers." So we made him a wizard.

@AdamBLiv is now a playable hero in SUPER SAYLOR: a robe, an orange tie, and alchemy that turns FUD bears into sats.

Meet him in the treasury era, then play as him.
